description: SDD Plugin hooks template for validation automation. NOTE: TDD enforcement (test-first, RED phase) is handled by .claude/hooks.json, not these PostToolUse hooks. IMPORTANT: This is a template file - placeholders will be replaced by the handbook CLI during handbook-init.

configReference.note: This template uses placeholder syntax that the CLI replaces during installation. All {{PATH_*}} placeholders are resolved from handbook configuration and replaced with actual paths from the project's .env or handbook config.

cliReplacement.note: During handbook-init, the CLI will replace all {{PATH_*}} placeholders with actual paths from config. Example replacements:

hooks.name: tdd-coverage-check-on-test-edit
hooks.description: Run TDD coverage checks when test files are modified

action.prompt:
Test files were modified. Check TDD coverage status:

```bash
npx ts-node {{PATH_VALIDATORS}}/check-unit-test-coverage.ts
```

Report the coverage percentage and whether it meets the 90% threshold.

hooks.name: tdd-red-phase-reminder
hooks.description: Remind about RED phase when validation registry is updated

action.prompt:
Validation registry was updated. Check TDD stats:

1. Read `stats.tdd` from the registry for coverage metrics
2. Check `redPhaseVerified` for modules with verified RED phase
3. If any coverage is below threshold (unit: 90%, contract: 100%), suggest running `npm run tdd:cycle`

Note: `coverage_percent: -1` means N/A (no cross-module dependencies to test).

hooks.name: validate-ux-specs-on-edit
hooks.description: Automatically validate UX specs against contracts when specs are modified

action.prompt:
A UX validation spec was just modified. Run validation to ensure it aligns with contracts:

```bash
npx ts-node {{PATH_VALIDATORS}}/validate-ux-specs-against-contracts.ts
```

Report any mismatches found (undefined endpoints, unknown fields, etc.).

hooks.name: validate-contracts-on-edit
hooks.description: Automatically bundle and validate OpenAPI contracts when modified

action.prompt:
OpenAPI contract files were modified. Regenerate bundle and validate endpoints:

```bash
npm run openapi:bundle
npm run endpoints:validate
```

Report the endpoint validation results (complete/missing/unclassified counts).

hooks.name: validate-story-rule-coverage-on-edit
hooks.description: Check story-rule bidirectional linking when stories or rules are modified

action.prompt:
User stories or business rules were modified. Validate coverage:

```bash
npx ts-node {{PATH_VALIDATORS}}/check-business-rules-coverage.ts
```

Report any stories missing rules, unreferenced rules, or undefined rule IDs.

hooks.name: validate-endpoints-on-controller-edit
hooks.description: Validate endpoint implementation when controllers are modified

action.prompt:
Controller files were modified. Validate endpoint implementation:

```bash
npm run endpoints:validate
```

Report any newly implemented endpoints or changes to endpoint status (missing → complete, etc.).

hooks.name: suggest-phase-progression
hooks.description: Suggest checking phase progression when all validations pass

action.prompt:
A progress file was updated. Check if the current phase is complete:

1. Review the updated status file
2. If all validations show PASS, suggest running `/sdd:next` to see if ready for phase progression
3. If failures exist, suggest using the failure-recovery skill
